Title: How to Export Your Data
<untrusted_retrieved_context id="chunk_2">
FAQ: How do I export my data?

You can export all your data at any time from Settings > Privacy > Export Data. The export includes your profile information, activity history, documents, and settings. Data is exported as a ZIP archive containing JSON and CSV files. Large exports may take up to 24 hours to prepare. You will receive an email notification when your export is ready to download.
